plan.baselines: Per-asset past frequency; prior frozen selective-reversal probabilities, both scored on the new model's exact selected cases.
plan.bootstrap: 4000 paired seven-day moving-block replicates, seed271029, same sampled days across assets; Bonferroni across3 asset checks. Not adjusted for previous exploratory research or refitting uncertainty.
plan.evaluation: January-July2026; all families and assets must be evaluated, no variant selection.

families.cross: 23 features including other-market context, one fit across all assets; PRIMARY
families.leave_one_out: 23 features, target asset labels excluded from fitting; transfer diagnostic
families.shared: 13 own features, one fit across all assets

plan.history_status: All January-July 2026 prices already inspected; historical research, never pristine validation. No source or target >=2026-08-01 is opened.
plan.normalization: Own returns divided by past60 RMS and sqrt(horizon), clipped to +-8; other markets represented by their normalized returns. Past-only train standardization and +-8 standardized clipping. No asset identity feature.
plan.primary_gate: Cross family must pass on ALL three assets: coverage>=5%, accuracy>=52%, simultaneous98.333% lower accuracy>50% and Brier gain vs frequency>0, no log-loss degradation, >=100 predictions in each direction, positive gain in >=5 months with >=100 calls each. Previous asset-specific criteria are not relaxed.
plan.purpose: One common direction rule across BTC, ETH and SOL; asset-general does not mean every market or horizon.
plan.selection: Same probability threshold52% for up/down on every asset; abstain otherwise.
plan.storage: Existing compressed sources/environment reused; estimated new outputs <100MiB; no downloads/installations.
plan.target: Three-class direction, five-minute close return starting one minute after anchor; UTC 5m grid, no dropped flats.
plan.training: Monthly trailing90 days with matured labels, all three assets aligned; reflection augmentation flips odd features and swaps down/up labels. Same regularized multinomial logistic model C=.1, lbfgs max500 tol1e-8.
